rows.role_title: President of the Indian National Congress
rows.text: The party journal reports that 'Mrs. Sonia Gandhi was elected the Congress President with thumping majority on 15th November, 2000 defeating her rival, Mr. Jitendra Prasada': total electorate 7,848; votes polled 7,771; rejected 229; valid 7,542; Mrs. Sonia Gandhi 7,448; Mr. Jitendra Prasada 94.

locator.section: article 'Sonia Gandhi Elected President', paragraph 1 and the table 'Election Of Congress President - 2000'

rows.role_title: President of the Indian National Congress
rows.text: The same article says Central Election Authority chairman Ram Niwas Mirdha formally disclosed the voting figures, declared Mrs. Sonia Gandhi president of the party and ceremoniously handed over the certificate of election; she thanked the voters and partymen in a brief speech and, later talking to journalists, said she had called a meeting of the Congress Chief Ministers on 18th November.
